turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Describe a frontend feature you worked on. How did data move from a user action to the interface, and what did you implement?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Um, I think the clearest example is the queue search. I personally connected the input change to a debounced request and stored the returned rows in state. I attached a request number and ignored a response if its number was no longer current. As far as I remember, the endpoint itself was unchanged and belonged to another team.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Walk me through a user-facing defect you investigated. What did you observe, and how did you decide what was causing it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Uh, I may not remember the exact delay, but I reproduced old results by holding the first response in the browser. I saw the second response render before the first arrived, then logged a later state write from the older request. That supports response order as the explanation for the reproduced issue, not every production complaint.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How did you check the change and decide it was ready for release?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Um, I wrote a mocked-request test that resolved responses in reverse order and asserted that the newer rows remained. I also rejected a mocked request and asserted that the retry button appeared. I did not connect these tests to the real service.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What accessibility work or checks did you perform on this interface?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I added a descriptive label to the retry button and checked that Enter activated it after tabbing to it. I could see the focus indicator. I am not sure how its loading announcement behaves with a screen reader because I did not test one.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Looking back, what were the limits of your ownership or evidence, and what would you investigate or ask for help with next?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I am cautious about claiming more than my reproduction and local checks. I did not measure production impact. I would confirm the real-service behavior and screen-reader announcement next.
